title: Chile Pasilla Oaxaqueño Salsa Recipe (Authentic & Smoky)
ldKeywords: homemade authentic salsa, Mexican salsa recipe, Salsa oaxaqueño recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 5  chiles pasillas (preferably Oaxaqueños, stemmed and seeded)
ldInstructionsRaw: Roast tomatillos on a flat grill for 10 to 15 minutes or until soft.
Next roast chiles until soft and cover with hot water in a bowl to soften.
Blend chiles, garlic, and salt until smooth then add tomatillos and pulse blender two to three times to maintain a thick consistency.
